policyStatement: Opstalia searches its current registry of supported official repositories.

sources.description: Archival descriptions, authority records, digital objects, OCR, and extracted text in the National Archives Catalog.
sources.authentication: Server-side x-api-key supplied only through NARA_API_KEY
sources.rateLimit: Default 10,000 queries per month per API key
sources.robotsAndTerms: Use the documented API, not Catalog HTML. Current API terms prohibit caching or storing returned content and require attribution.
sources.implementationMethod: Cloudflare Worker POST proxy with fixed upstream, schema checks, no source-response cache, and no request-body logging
knownLimitations: Requires a secret-backed Worker
API content is transient and not persisted by Opstalia
Digitized does not mean declassified or released in full
Catalog indexing and metadata may be incomplete

sources.displayName: NARA JFK Assassination Records — 2025 Release Page
sources.description: Official NARA release-file index for JFK assassination records listed on the 2025 Documents Release page, including later files currently included in that page's table.
sources.apiAvailability: No documented structured API; Opstalia builds a pinned index from the official server-rendered NARA table
sources.rateLimit: No API rate limit; archives.gov robots specifies a 10-second crawl delay
sources.robotsAndTerms: A scheduled build fetches the single official release page, validates its table and links, and records its hash. Runtime search uses the checked-in same-origin index and links to NARA PDFs; Opstalia does not mirror the PDFs.
sources.implementationMethod: Opt-in browser-side search of a guarded, build-time index containing only NARA-reported filenames, RIF identifiers, the raw source-table row date for audit, and official archives.gov PDF links
fieldsReturned: raw source-table row date for audit only
knownLimitations: The current NARA page includes a January 30, 2026 batch even though its title and file paths refer to 2025

All current table rows report March 18, 2025, so Opstalia retains that value only in the raw index record for audit and does not normalize it as a file release date or infer each file's actual release batch
This filename-level index does not ingest PDF text, OCR, page counts, or document dates
Multiple official files may share one base RIF; Opstalia preserves each distinct official URL
A posted official PDF does not by itself establish release in full
NARA warns that records may contain personally identifiable information and that some materials may be copyrighted
The unofficial doctly/jfk Markdown corpus is not searched, indexed, or presented as official release evidence
sources.manualSearchLabel: Open official NARA JFK release page

sources.agency: Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.description: The official published documentary record of major U.S. foreign-policy decisions and significant diplomatic activity.
sources.apiAvailability: No documented document-search API; the documented OPDS API is volume-level. Opstalia searches a pinned index built from the Office's official TEI project.
sources.rateLimit: No runtime requests; index is generated at build time
sources.robotsAndTerms: history.state.gov disallows automated /search access. Runtime scraping is disabled.
sources.implementationMethod: Client-side search of a version-pinned TEI-derived index; canonical result URLs remain on history.state.gov
knownLimitations: The checked-in 1.0 index covers 752 documents in three 1981–1988 volumes, not the entire series
FRUS is an edited official publication, not necessarily a facsimile
Bracketed omissions and editorial notes are not automatically archival redactions

sources.description: Documents and decision notices released by the Interagency Security Classification Appeals Panel.
sources.apiAvailability: No API; official server-rendered release table
sources.rateLimit: No published API rate limit; archives.gov robots sets a 10-second crawl delay
sources.robotsAndTerms: A scheduled build imports the official table once and records its hash; no runtime scraping.
sources.implementationMethod: Pinned local index generated from the official releases table
knownLimitations: A posted PDF is not automatically a full release
Affirmed decisions may provide only a notification
Table structure can change

sources.description: Quarterly NDC lists of record series and projects that completed declassification processing.
sources.apiAvailability: No API; quarterly official XLSX and PDF release lists
sources.rateLimit: No published API rate limit; archives.gov robots sets a 10-second crawl delay
sources.robotsAndTerms: A scheduled build imports the registered XLSX once after content-type, size, structure, and hash validation.
sources.implementationMethod: Pinned local index generated from the official FY2026 Q3 XLSX release list
knownLimitations: Entries are generally series-level finding aids, not item-level released documents
Records may require additional access or FOIA screening
Completion of declassification processing does not establish online availability

sources.description: Official CIA electronic reading room for declassified and FOIA-released records.
sources.robotsAndTerms: CIA robots disallows Reading Room search, advanced-search, and JSON paths. Automated retrieval is disabled.
sources.implementationMethod: Outage-aware retry worksheet with copyable terms and working official status and publication fallbacks
knownLimitations: The Reading Room showed a redirect loop during 2026-07-29 validation
No normalized results until the researcher records an official source
Search and OCR may be incomplete

sources.displayName: Department of State FOIA Virtual Reading Room

knownLimitations: OCR errors affect retrieval
Records may originate with other agencies
No normalized results until a researcher records an official source

sources.displayName: CIA records held by NARA — Catalog RG 263
sources.description: Automated discovery of online textual NARA Catalog records in Record Group 263, Records of the Central Intelligence Agency.
sources.apiAvailability: Documented NARA Catalog API v2 with recordGroupNumber fixed to 263
sources.authentication: Server-side x-api-key supplied only through NARA_API_KEY
sources.robotsAndTerms: Uses the documented NARA Catalog API, not CIA Reading Room search pages. NARA API content is transient and is not persisted.
sources.implementationMethod: Opt-in Cloudflare Worker NARA Catalog profile constrained to available-online textual records in RG 263, with returned-hierarchy verification
knownLimitations: This profile is opt-in because it shares the NARA API quota with the general Catalog adapter
This adapter searches NARA-held RG 263 records; it does not search the native CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room
Record Group 263 does not contain every CIA-created, CIA-related, or CIA-released record
The online-textual filter omits undigitized descriptions and non-textual holdings
NARA API content is transient and is not persisted by Opstalia
Catalog indexing, digitization, and OCR may be incomplete

sources.displayName: Department of State records held by NARA — Catalog RG 59
sources.description: Automated discovery of online textual NARA Catalog records in Record Group 59, General Records of the Department of State.
sources.apiAvailability: Documented NARA Catalog API v2 with recordGroupNumber fixed to 59
sources.authentication: Server-side x-api-key supplied only through NARA_API_KEY
sources.robotsAndTerms: Uses the documented NARA Catalog API, not State FOIA search pages. NARA API content is transient and is not persisted.
sources.implementationMethod: Opt-in Cloudflare Worker NARA Catalog profile constrained to available-online textual records in RG 59, with returned-hierarchy verification
knownLimitations: This profile is opt-in because it shares the NARA API quota with the general Catalog adapter
This adapter searches NARA-held RG 59 records; it does not search the native Department of State FOIA Virtual Reading Room
Record Group 59 does not contain every State Department record or FOIA release
The online-textual filter omits undigitized descriptions, non-textual holdings, and separate Foreign Service Post records in RG 84
NARA API content is transient and is not persisted by Opstalia
Catalog indexing, digitization, and OCR may be incomplete

sources.description: Official presidential-library systems, Bush Library finding aids, and NARA-hosted digital collections.
sources.apiAvailability: Some holdings are represented in the NARA Catalog API; no single complete libraries API
sources.robotsAndTerms: Library-host rules vary; no automated library scraping is enabled.
sources.implementationMethod: Manual directory plus NARA Catalog discovery where represented; the PDF Packet Lab uses prefix-only admission followed by one bounded full-source stream for local browser parsing and a separate second stream for derivative export
knownLimitations: Catalog coverage does not include every library holding
Library sites and search systems differ

The Packet Lab does not scrape library sites and initially accepts only catalog.archives.gov/medialz/presidential-libraries PDFs plus a researcher-supplied canonical NAID record locator; Opstalia does not independently prove that association
Packet Lab sources above 100 MiB are unsupported; opening downloads one complete copy into browser memory, and derivative export downloads a second copy and requires matching browser-computed SHA-256
NARA or Cloudflare may not expose a usable Content-Length or ETag to the Worker; the hard streaming cap and browser-computed length and hash remain controlling
The Worker caches and stores no PDF bytes
